chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down into Water, [ ... ]
chapter_note: Dominantly correspondential-cosmological teaching: a natural phenomenon (reflection/shadow) is mapped onto cosmic process (the Summons descending to the Worlds of Darkness; the Obedience ascending to the Living Spirit; astral/zodiacal generation; embodiment from earth/abyss). Later compilation frame survives mainly as dialogue attributions and didactic address (“I reveal… to you”), which can be cleanly stripped. No clear NT overlay appears in the extant paragraphs; the main secondary layer here is the hagiographic dialogue frame and occasional application voice.

paragraphs.core_text: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue-frame and petition: “[Once again, one of his disciples asked the apostle ...] instruct me about this lesson:”. This is hagiographic compilation framing (disciple/apostle address), while the remaining question is the substantive natural-problem prompt for the correspondential teaching.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The “disciple/apostle” attribution is later frame; the bare problem statement about reflection functions as the teaching’s natural correspondential datum and can stand without the frame.

paragraphs.core_text: Happen you know this, that this universe is established [of m]ystery, and is entirely full of mystery.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “Then the apostle says to him:”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Frame marker “apostle says” is late; the aphoristic cosmological premise (“universe… full of mystery”) fits the impersonal teaching voice once detached from the dialogue wrapper.

paragraphs.core_text: [And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce ...] in this way it cast itself down [...] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic cosmos→cosmos correspondence: inverted reflection → the Summons’ descent to the Worlds of Darkness/First Man; impersonal explanatory voice without institutional pointing.

paragraphs.core_text: And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed explicit didactic/application clause: “This is a spiritual mystery that I have [revea]led to you so that you would understand it.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core mapping continues (reflection condition → Obedience ascending First Man→Living Spirit), but the closing self-referential address (“I revealed… to you”) signals later pedagogical/application voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed opening invitation/exhortation: “If you wish to understand another corporeal mystery on this subject, listen and I may teach you to understand it.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying substrate is a cosmological-astral correspondence (reflection inversion → stars/zodiac in the ‘great sea’ as generating ‘fathers’). The prefatory ‘listen/I may teach you’ is later instructional staging.

paragraphs.core_text: Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Natural-process correspondence (foetal inversion/birth) presented as a ‘mystery’ revealed through water-reflection; no institutional anchoring or citation formulas.

paragraphs.core_text: Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [...] his shadow up upon the earth [...] above. It is impossible for him to do [... ...] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed introductory disclosure formula: “Furthermore, I reveal something else to you:”.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core correspondential teaching: shadow-fastened-to-earth → body’s origin from earth/abyss and its ‘hanging’ relation. The initial ‘I reveal… to you’ is a late didactic seam, but the rest remains impersonal cosmological explanation.
